items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah, yeah. See, Jonah Jones was in the band. ... [INTERVIEWER] Well, Horace Henderson's band... I remember once you and Jonah at Ryan's, singing "Beau-Koo Jack." [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, at Ryan's, yeah!

ctx.x: And that was a full-sized band with what? Three trumpets...

Oh yeah, yeah. See, Jonah Jones was in the band. Jonah Jones and a good trumpet player, I guess he's dead now, Matthew Harlan. You ever hear of him? Boy, that cat could swing, man. He was from Louisville, too. Myself. In fact, I can't remember nobody else in that band... That's
